metadata.description: Font registration via @font, canvas inheritance, standalone SVG Base64 embedding, and Photopea synchronization

standalone_svg_base64.description: SVG exporter automatically converts local .ttf/.otf binaries into Base64 data URLs inside @font-face defs, ensuring 100% portable vector rendering without system font fallbacks.

photopea_fonts_synchronization.rule: Keep local project './fonts/' directory up to date at all times with all font binaries used.
photopea_fonts_synchronization.workflow: Enables users to drag and drop the font files directly into Photopea so PSD Type Layers render natively without missing font alerts or substitution distortion.
